meta.title: ASME B16.5 pressure-temperature ratings, material group 1.1 (e.g. A105 / A216 WCB / A515-70 / A516-70 / A350 LF2), working pressure in bar (gauge)
meta.standard: ASME B16.5 Table 2-1.1 (metric ratings in bar). Paywalled: only the values below, quoted by public secondary sources, are used.

sources.S5: Engineering ToolBox, 'Carbon Steel Flanges - Group 1.1 Pressure and Temperature Ratings', https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-flanges-pressure-rating-d_49.html (search-engine extract, 2026-10-18)
sources.S6: Fike Corporation technical bulletin citing ASME B16.5-2017, https://my.fike.com/phoenix/api/files/download/?did=6411 (search-engine extract, 2026-10-18)
sources.S7: Project Materials, 'ASME B16.5 PT Rating Tables Explained' and 'Flange Class 150 vs 300' (285 psig / 740 psig at -20..100 F for group 1.1), https://www.blog.projectmaterials.com/quick-answers/flanges/asme-b16-5-pt-rating-tables/ (search extract)

meta.interpolation: Linear interpolation between tabulated temperatures is permitted (S7 extract; B16.5 para. 2.3 as quoted by secondary sources).

units.temperatureC: degC (upper bound of the band; the first band is -29..38)

notInUse: Intermediate temperatures for classes >= 300 above 50 C: secondary sources disagree (e.g. Class 300 at 400 F: 635 vs 600 psig) - grade C, never gates.
